purpose: Each criterion of US-20503 asserted on what bin/rcf.js prints or writes: the block through rcf guidance, rcf init in a fresh directory, rcf doctor and rcf doctor --fix over test/fixtures/managed-block-0-40-1/CLAUDE.md (the block the 0.40.1 rcf init wrote).
title: The twelve-rule managed block through rcf guidance, rcf init and rcf doctor (through bin/rcf.js)

testCases.description: rcf guidance managed/agent-instructions-block prints RULE 13 as "Deliver in rounds: the twelve rules" with the twelve rules in order, none of the operator-register or five-role text, and RULE 1 to 12 and 14 to 17 under their headings. Amended at DEFINE pass 2 (ruling 13, G3): the test parses the block into its regions and proves, against the 0.40.1 block's own regions, that the headings are the 0.40.1 headings with RULE 13 renamed, the operator-register region is absent, RULE 13 carries the twelve rules in order with rules 5 and 6 verbatim, and the Build loop keeps exactly its rcf commands with no five-role sentence
testCases.testPointer: test/guidance/twelve-rules-0-41-0.test.js::AC-20503-1: rcf guidance managed/agent-instructions-block prints RULE 13 as "Deliver in rounds: the twelve rules" with the twelve rules in order, none of the operator-register or five-role text, and RULE 1 to 12 and 14 to 17 under their headings

testCases.description: rcf init in a fresh directory writes the twelve-rule block between the managed markers of CLAUDE.md and of AGENTS.md
testCases.testPointer: test/guidance/twelve-rules-0-41-0.test.js::AC-20503-2: rcf init in a fresh directory writes the twelve-rule block between the managed markers of CLAUDE.md and of AGENTS.md

testCases.description: on a project whose CLAUDE.md carries the 0.40.1 block, rcf doctor exits 3 naming the stale block, rcf doctor --fix rewrites only the text between the markers, and a second rcf doctor exits 0
